meta.name: derisk-measurement-advisor
meta.description: Identify what to measure, test, or track to de-risk a product or AI idea. Use when stress-testing an idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确定要测量与跟踪的指标,让产品想法风险可控
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在验证新产品或 AI 想法的可行性
copy.tagline_en: Decide what to measure to reduce risk of your product idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're validating a new product or AI idea

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会提问了解你的产品想法、阶段和客户,按 4 个内部维度(需求、易用、可行、盈利)和 6 个外部维度(PESTEL)逐项扫风险,标成「立即行动」或「开始跟踪」,最后给出带优先级的风险清单和下一步。
howto.when: 当你提出对某个产品或 AI 想法做风险评估,或问“该测什么”“会出什么问题”时触发。入口例如:“帮我去风险化这个XX。”

say.text: 帮我评估这个AI想法:自动生成保险理赔回复的代理,原型阶段。
say.note: 它会进入引导问答,按10个维度展开扫描。

say.text: 我有个产品想法,先告诉我最该测的几个指标。
say.note: 它会聚焦内部维度,让你挑选关键测试。

say.text: 上线前帮我把内部和外部风险过一遍,标出要先行动的。
say.note: 它会扫描10个维度,并给出行动/跟踪分类。

howto.what_en: Claude asks about your product idea, then scans 10 risk dimensions (4 internal: DUFV; 6 external: PESTEL), tags each act-now or track, and outputs a prioritized risk register.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to stress-test a product or AI idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions, e.g. what should I measure or what could go wrong.

say_en.text: Assess this idea: an AI agent that auto-drafts claim responses, prototype.
say_en.note: It starts guided questioning across 10 risk dimensions.

say_en.text: I have a product idea. What metrics should I test first?
say_en.note: It walks internal dimensions and asks you to pick key tests.

say_en.text: Before launch, scan internal and external risks and mark act-now items.
say_en.note: It produces a prioritized register with act vs track labels.
